This '''Sith trooper''' was a member of the [[Darth Krayt's Sith trooper|army]] secretly assembled in [[138 ABY]] by [[Darth Krayt]], [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] of the [[One Sith]]. A sentient being [[Force-sensitive/Legends|attuned]] to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], the trooper had undergone a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]] grafting process from infancy in order to be physically augmented and improved for combat, and forged into an unquestionably loyal servant.

[[File:Unidentified_Sith_trooper.png|thumb|left|170px|The trooper attacks [[Cade Skywalker]].]]

He, along with other troopers, joined the [[Attack on the Hidden Temple|attack]] on the [[Hidden Temple (Sith–Imperial War)|Hidden Temple]] on [[Taivas]] in 138 ABY. As Krayt's enemies were occupied holding back the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]], the [[Dread Lord]] unleashed his secret army of Sith troopers. They were able to turn the battle towards Krayt's favor, destroying much of the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Empire's]] ground assault forces in the process. After the death of [[Rawk|Nat Skywalker]], his nephew, [[Cade Skywalker|Cade]], succumbed to his anger and unleashed a ferocious wave of attacks against the Sith troopers. Cade was about to kill this trooper, but his mother, [[Morrigan Corde]], convinced him to keep him alive to further study Krayt's newest weapon.

The trooper was taken to [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]], where he was examined by an [[Fel Empire|Imperial]] [[Unidentified Imperial doctor (Fel Empire)|doctor]]. The study revealed that he was fully integrated into his armor and could hardwire himself into his [[Annihilator-class starfighter|''Annihilator'' fighter]] using portals at the termination of his cybernetic grafts. The trooper succumbed to his wounds three days after his capture.
